answer: Give every identity the same job with one secret detail quietly varied, a shifted price or a swapped landmark, so each voyage is alike but never identical. A lone sparrow solves the version it was handed; a farm running one shared brain leaks answers across clones, replying with a sibling's detail, and those cross-matched errors link the whole flock at once. Like a willow whose branches all bend from one hidden root, linked clones expose themselves by their shared mistakes, and linked identities earn as one, so splitting gains nothing.
